definitions.explanation: A commercial establishment where customers rent a table and play mahjong, usually by the hour. They are a familiar feature of station-front buildings and of student and office-worker life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雀荘|じゃんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a mahjong parlor in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {大学時代|だいがくじだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{雀荘|じゃんそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っていた→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: In my university days I used to go to the mahjong parlor a lot.

examples.japanese: {雀荘|じゃんそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{打|う}っていた→打つ：01221_utsu⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{寝|ね}て→寝る：00470_neru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Because I was playing at the mahjong parlor until morning, I slept through all my classes.

notes:
The {雀|じゃん} is from ⟦{麻雀|マージャン}→麻雀：06986_maajan⟧ (mahjong), and {荘|そう} is the same "lodge, villa" character found in apartment-building names. Note the irregular reading: {雀|じゃん} here, not すずめ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雀荘|じゃんそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to frequent a mahjong parlor
- {雀荘|じゃんそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to play (mahjong) at a parlor — ⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ is the standard verb for playing mahjong
- ⟦フリー→フリー：11001_furii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雀荘|じゃんそう}: a parlor where solo customers are matched into a group

CULTURAL NOTE:
Parlors advertise themselves as ノーレート (no stakes) or by the rate played. In fiction and memoirs the {雀荘|じゃんそう} is a stock setting for all-night student life.
